requirement_evidence.evidence: Verified cryptographic protocol seal before test split load. Recorded KNOWN_TEST_EXPLORATORY exposure disclosure in replay_results.json without claiming untouched confirmation. Verified by test_w4_032_c01_seal_and_test_disclosure.

Replayed stream in exact chronological order (sorted by exp, win_idx) with recording resets. Evaluated exactly 5,053 windows, 19 recordings, and 5,034 adjacent within-recording pairs. Verified by test_w4_032_c02_exact_denominators_and_chronology.

Logged query-level trace in replay_trace.csv with 17 mandatory columns (global_row_id, recording_id, step_idx, method_id, action, event, reason, predicted_class, reference_class, is_agreement, is_reuse, is_formal_reuse, is_singleton_reuse, is_regional_reuse, stratum, ground_truth_label, elapsed_ms). Verified by test_w4_032_c03_c04_trace_columns_and_shadow_reference.

Shadow reference (M00) evaluated outside per-method operational timers. Achieved 100% decision agreement between M00, M01, M03 against reference forward. Verified by test_w4_032_c03_c04_trace_columns_and_shadow_reference.

Recorded separate counters for R, D_reuse, D_fallback, D_all, A_reuse, and A_full. Enforced null A_reuse when R=0. Evaluated supervised activity metrics (Accuracy: 89.05%, Macro-F1: 0.7763) strictly on 3,572 labeled queries joined post-decision. Verified by test_w4_032_c05_separate_accounting_and_null_rule.
Reported exact strata counts: 2,874 pure-basic, 119 pure-transition, 579 majority-mixed, 479 ambiguous, 1,002 unlabeled (sum = 5,053). Verified by test_w4_032_c06_strata_classification_and_counts.

Distinguished exact singleton replay (M02), incremental feature reuse (M03: R=5034, D_all=0, A_reuse=1.0), and regional certification (M05-M13). Retained all 17 registered methods in method_execution_status.json (15 EXECUTED, 2 AUDITED_UNSUPPORTED). Verified by test_w4_032_c07_methods_status_retention.
